DEFAULT_SP_GUI

Engine start state for the Earth Playground — the hardcoded baseline the scene boots with before any CMS defaults node or user localStorage overrides merge in. Values were hand-tuned visually; each block maps to one earth-background.js subsystem (post-fx chain, moon orbit, sun, atmosphere scattering, ocean BRDF, camera orbit).
